title: Global Orchestrator Watcher
summary: Decision dossier for a global intelligent exception layer above the mechanical delivery invariants. The central event bus is the shared substrate: the Watcher consumes typed escalation, integration, delivery, starvation, stale, loop, and contradiction signals, then publishes findings, recipe receipts, analyses, and decision needs into the same All-Activity-default stream. Three theme-aware mockups show interleaved Activity entries, persistent Studio-shell presence, and an AGT-2531 NoTaskBranch finding detail. The observe-first recommendation and approval-gated fence policy remain unchanged. Extended 06.09.2026 (§10): autonomous problem finding with five detector classes (repetition, contradiction, silence, drift, hygiene) seeded from the eight findings the operator made by hand that evening, findings as ticket proposals, a dedicated Watcher contingent, a proposal review mode with operator approval and a promotion rule for auto-approval, and an extended decision request. [Curation 2026-09-07 (AGT-2671): DONE CHECK - the pilot decision is still open, so this stays decision-pending and does not move to History. Section 8a's already-shipped visual QA guardian (AGT-2654) is cited as a precedent pattern in docs/concepts/platform-architecture/telemetry-layer.md. The remaining architecture content (WatcherCase contract, capability ladder, autonomy classes) and the §10 autonomous-problem-finding extension were deliberately not transferred to the architecture docs, so that an unapproved mechanism is not documented as settled.]
